title: fix(console): Studio condition editors list fields by their label
body:
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_ Fixes #34122 Clause-②: no (`@object-ui/app-shell` is `"private": true`; flipping the `labelSubjects` default reaches no published export) Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：Studio 条件编辑器（Hook「仅当…时运行」、操作的「显示条件 / 禁用条件」、页面区块「显示条件」、元数据表单里的通用条件字段）的字段下拉，改为「字段标签为主、机器名在旁」；`ConditionBuilder` 的 `labelSubjects` 默认值翻为开启。 - 为什么改：其余入口只显示 `status` 这类机器名，与流程「进入条件」和对象校验已有的标签显示不一致，作者要猜字段。 - 风险与回滚：只改显示文字，生成的 CEL 条件不变；回滚即把默认值改回 `false`（一行）。没有标签、或标签与字段名相同的字段仍显示机器名。 - 先看：`ConditionBuilder.tsx` 中 `labelSubjects = true` 默认值与 `labelOf` 那段；`ConditionBuilder.mountScope.test.tsx` 末尾的四个挂载点用例；`ConditionBuilder.subjectVocabulary.test.tsx` 的 `spellingOf`（被迫改动的旧用例）。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ConditionBuilder.mountScope.test.tsx`，预期全部通过，含 "every mount names a field subject by its label" 四例。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes `ConditionBuilder`'s `labelSubjects` now defaults to `true`, so every remaining mount names a field subject by its label with its CEL spelling as the hint (`ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names`). A field with no label, or whose label only repeats its name (the object-field catalog fills an unlabelled field's label with its name), reads as its spelling alone. The compiled CEL is unchanged. **The default-flip decision (the card's Ask):** flip it. Every `ConditionBuilder` mount in the tree (`git grep 'Wide run — the whole @object-ui/app-shell package, type-check + tests (head b6d441814b) `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check && cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/"` ``` Test Files 2330 passed | 1 skipped (2331) Tests 21781 passed | 9 skipped (21790) os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 ``` `type-check` is both programs (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`); the two earlier wide attempts went red there, which is what the `labelOf` local and the complete `WidgetContext` commits fix.
Targeted run before the forced edits (head 359883a3a0) and after (head c31d3c85d1) Before (the resume head merged with main): `Test Files 4 failed | 13 passed (17)`, `Tests 7 failed | 171 passed (178)` — exactly the seven pins listed above. After the forced edits: `Test Files 17 passed (17)`, `Tests 178 passed (178)`.
Ablations ran on head `060a33c371` (the final head only adds a local in the `previous.FIELD` label and a test-context key since).
Ablation 1 — default flipped back to false (anchor labelSubjects = true, verdictPath }) Mutation landed by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `40845f46e22b` → `ed604132839a`), 8 files run: `Test Files 6 failed | 2 passed (8)`, `Tests 9 failed | 100 passed (109)`. Red: the four mount pins, the widget pin, the 27521 default pin, and the three forced-edit pickers (nullGuard, typedEmptyOps, COMPILES). Every CONTROL stayed green. Restored: blob == HEAD (`40845f46e22b`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
Ablation 2 — a label that repeats the name counts as a label (anchor (f.label && f.label !== f.name ? f.label : undefined) → (f.label)) Mutation landed (blob `40845f46e22b` → `0ba9b3f964d0`): `Test Files 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`, `Tests 5 failed | 25 passed (30)`. Red: the four mount pins (their CONTROL `code` field arrives from the catalog labelled `code`) and the 27521 name-only pin. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
Derived gate families (dispatch-gates --commands, head b6d441814b) All 38 derived families exit 0, including `check:test-source-alias`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (`Test Files 171 passed | 2 skipped (173)`). Reconciliation: ``` Run reconciliation — 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. ``` Also `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`. `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` before each push: `VERDICT clean exit 0`.
